CHILDCLASS.Settings.AbilityRule.Name: Ability score generation rule
CHILDCLASS.Settings.AbilityRule.Hint: Which dice a new Child rolls for ability scores. Unexceptional is wider (6+1d6 → 7-12 per score); Unremarkable is tighter (7+1d4 → 8-11). Existing Children keep the rule they were rolled under, even if this setting changes later.
CHILDCLASS.Settings.XpOnGraduation.Name: XP handling at graduation
CHILDCLASS.Settings.XpOnGraduation.Hint: Default XP mode offered in the graduation dialog. Reset uses the RAW minimum for the new character level; carry keeps the Child's total; milestone zeroes it.
CHILDCLASS.Settings.EnforceMulticlassBlo: Block a Child from taking a second class and prevent non-Children from taking a Child level. Turn off only if your table means to break the rules.
CHILDCLASS.Settings.SnapshotRetentionDay: How many days the pre-graduation snapshot is kept before the Undo option disappears. 0 = never auto-clear.
CHILDCLASS.Settings.AllowMixedEditions.N: Allow mixed editions in one world
CHILDCLASS.Settings.AllowMixedEditions.H: Whether one world may contain both '14 and '24 Children. Off enforces a single edition per world. A single actor may never hold both editions regardless of this setting.
CHILDCLASS.Settings.AutoFireDialogs.Name: Auto-open Child dialogs
CHILDCLASS.Settings.AutoFireDialogs.Hint: When on, the ability roll dialog opens automatically as soon as a Child class is dropped on a fresh actor, Growth opens on level 4, and Trade Skill fires on level 5. Off leaves the flows manual — the GM invokes them from the API when ready.
CHILDCLASS.Settings.VerboseLogging.Name: Verbose console logging
CHILDCLASS.Settings.VerboseLogging.Hint: Emit per-render diagnostic messages to the F12 console. Useful when debugging a stuck Knack picker or a prereq bypass that isn't taking. Off in normal play.
